Build a Memory Brain management page for Claude Hub. The app is at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub`.

## What to build

### 1. Backend — `src/server.js`

Add these endpoints after the existing `/api/global/settings` block (around line 1023). The memory dir is `~/.claude/memory/`. Security: paths must stay within `MEMORY_DIR`.

```js
const MEMORY_DIR = path.join(CLAUDE_DIR, 'memory');
```

**GET `/api/memory`** — return the full file tree as a nested array:
```json
[
  { "type": "dir", "name": "user", "path": "user", "children": [
    { "type": "file", "name": "profile.md", "path": "user/profile.md" }
  ]},
  { "type": "file", "name": "MEMORY.md", "path": "MEMORY.md" }
]
```
Build this recursively. Filter out `.DS_Store` and hidden files. Sort dirs first, then files, both alphabetically.

**GET `/api/memory/file?path=user/profile.md`** — return `{ path, content }`. Validate the resolved path stays within MEMORY_DIR. Return 404 if file doesn't exist.

**PUT `/api/memory/file`** — body `{ path, content }`. Validate path stays within MEMORY_DIR. Create parent dirs if needed. Write the file. Return `{ ok: true }`.

**POST `/api/memory/file`** — body `{ path }`. Create a new empty file (with default frontmatter template for .md files). Return `{ ok: true }`. Fail if file already exists.

**DELETE `/api/memory/file?path=user/profile.md`** — Delete the file. Validate path. Return `{ ok: true }`.

### 2. Frontend page — `client/src/pages/Memory.tsx`

A 3-panel layout:

**Left panel (240px)** — File tree
- Header: "Memory Brain" title + "New File" button (plus icon)
- Recursive tree: show folders (collapsible, open by default) and files
- File icons: `Brain` for MEMORY.md, `FolderOpen`/`Folder` for dirs, `FileText` for .md files
- Click a file → load in editor
- Hover on file row → show delete button (trash icon, confirm before deleting)
- "New File" button opens a small inline form at the top asking for the relative path (e.g. `user/new-memory.md`)

**Middle panel (flex-1)** — Editor
- When no file selected: empty state "Select a file to edit"
- Header shows current file path as breadcrumb
- `<textarea>` for editing the file content (monospace, full height)
- Save button (only enabled when dirty)
- Keyboard shortcut hint: Cmd+S to save (use `useEffect` with keydown listener)

**Right panel (260px)** — Info sidebar
- Show rendered preview of memory types if the file has frontmatter (`---\ntype: user|feedback|project|reference\n---`)
- If MEMORY.md: show quick stats (count of lines that start with `- [`)
- Memory type descriptions:
  - `user`: Who the user is — tailors future behavior
  - `feedback`: How to approach work — corrections and validations
  - `project`: Ongoing work context — goals, decisions, deadlines
  - `reference`: Pointers to external systems

Use existing Tailwind design tokens: `bg-surface`, `border-border`, `text-text`, `text-text-secondary`, `text-accent`, etc. Match the existing app style.

### 3. Wire it up

**`client/src/lib/api.ts`** — add:
```ts
export interface MemoryNode {
  type: 'file' | 'dir'
  name: string
  path: string
  children?: MemoryNode[]
}

export const getMemoryTree = () => get<MemoryNode[]>('/api/memory')
export const getMemoryFile = (filePath: string) => get<{ path: string; content: string }>(`/api/memory/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}`)
export const updateMemoryFile = (filePath: string, content: string) => put('/api/memory/file', { path: filePath, content })
export const createMemoryFile = (filePath: string) => post('/api/memory/file', { path: filePath })
export const deleteMemoryFile = (filePath: string) => del(`/api/memory/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(filePath)}`)
```

Check the existing `get`, `put`, `post` helpers in `client/src/lib/api.ts` before adding — use the same pattern. There may be a `del` function already or you may need to add it.

**`client/src/App.tsx`** — import `Memory` and add:
```tsx
<Route path="/memory" element={<Memory />} />
```

**`client/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`** — add under the "Global Config" section, after the CLAUDE.md NavLink:
```tsx
import { Brain } from 'lucide-react'
// ...
<NavLink to="/memory" className={navLinkClass}>
  <Brain className="w-4 h-4" />
  Memory Brain
</NavLink>
```

## Notes
- Read `client/src/lib/api.ts` first to understand existing helper pattern
- Read `client/src/pages/GlobalClaudeMd.tsx` for style reference
- Read `src/server.js` lines 1-30 to understand the CLAUDE_DIR and helper functions
- The app uses Tailwind v4 with CSS custom properties (`bg-surface`, `text-text`, etc.)
- TypeScript strict — no `any`
- After making all changes, restart pm2: `pm2 restart claude-hub --update-env`

136	export async function streamAiChat(
137	  messages: AiMessage[],
138	  system: string | undefined,
139	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
140	  signal?: AbortSignal,
141	): Promise<string> {
142	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
143	    method: 'POST',
144	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
145	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
146	    signal,
147	  })
148	  if (!res.ok) {
149	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
150	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
151	  }
152	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
153	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
154	  let buffer = ''
155	  let fullContent = ''
156	
157	  while (true) {
158	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
159	    if (done) break
160	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
161	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
162	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
163	    for (const line of parts) {
164	      const trimmed = line.trim()
165	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
166	      try {
167	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
168	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
169	          fullContent += event.content
170	          onChunk(event.content)
171	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
172	          fullContent = event.content
173	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
174	          throw new Error(event.error)
175	        }
176	      } catch (e) {
177	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
178	        throw e
179	      }
180	    }
181	  }
182	  return fullContent
183	}

Here's what was built:

**Backend — `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/claude-hub/src/server.js`**

Added after line 1023:
- `MEMORY_DIR` constant pointing to `~/.claude/memory`
- `resolveMemoryPath()` — path traversal guard, rejects anything outside `MEMORY_DIR`
- `buildMemoryTree()` — recursive dir walker, filters hidden files, sorts dirs-first alphabetically
- `GET /api/memory` — returns the full nested tree
- `GET /api/memory/file?path=` — reads a file with 404 on missing
- `PUT /api/memory/file` — writes content, creates parent dirs
- `POST /api/memory/file` — creates new file (with `.md` frontmatter template), errors on conflict
- `DELETE /api/memory/file?path=` — deletes with path validation
